# Quantum Thermometry Feedback — authoritative routes

Question: global minimax squared log-temperature error with exactly two fully equilibrated Gibbs-preparation batches, one classical feedback update, and a pathwise total N-qubit-use budget.
Main result: R_2^*(N)=Theta(N^(-3/2)). Root-mean-square log error is Theta(N^(-3/4)).

OVERVIEW: README.md — scientific result, scope and reading routes.
MODEL: science/model.md — fresh replacement, energy-label sufficiency, arbitrary instruments/memory, loss and charged resources.
THERMAL FOUNDATION: science/entropy_budget.md — Gibbs Fisher information, entropy-area identity and pointwise quadratic bound.
CONVERSE: science/two_batch_converse.md — posterior peak, posterior score identity, conditional area and van Trees.
ATTAINMENT: science/achievability.md — fixed-gap pilot, degenerate blocks, complete smoothed/clipped estimator and rare-error control.
ROUND LIMITS: science/round_complexity.md — converse-only for general fixed r; necessary log-log batch count for quadratic global precision.
PHYSICAL MEANING: science/interpretation.md — sensitivity/bandwidth and implementation boundaries.
ATTRIBUTION: references/RELATED_WORK.md — inherited Bayesian/probe-design ingredients, distinct two-batch contribution and explicit source-access limitation.
BIBLIOGRAPHY: references/references.bib.

LEARNING START: learning/README.md.
SINGLE ANCHOR: learning/ANCHOR.md — De Pasquale and Stace, Quantum Thermometry, arXiv:1807.05762v1 (2018); selected pages, translated notation and missing project-specific steps.
CONCEPTUAL MAP: learning/MILESTONES.md — exactly M01–M30; 12 background and 18 narrative targets; dependencies and canonical source routes.
WORKED EXAMPLES: learning/WORKED_EXAMPLES.md — pilot probabilities, full 1024-use accounting, endpoint counts and interpretation of numerical risk.
REPRODUCTION: verification/README.md — commands, finite checks, expected output and tail bounds.

Keep local sensitivity distinct from global risk, squared error from root mean square, qubit uses from elapsed time, and fresh Gibbs replacement from dynamical bath access. The r-round lower bound is not matching attainment for r>2. The source review's sequential probe is not the replacement experiment. Primary research citations are not additional educational anchors. Canonical proofs live in science/; the common learning map contains no personalized coaching or assessment records.
